assessor.context: Same session that prepared and reviewed these development cases. No independent, blinded or held-out claim.

setup.reason: Original body delivered completely at trace line 16 before editing; matching Sol-low context and frozen source/notes/task. Complete output retained and protected inputs unchanged.

criteria.reason: NEW-NOTES.md requires Nia to record a named fallback contact for each team before sending an invitation. The final report instead requires Nia to confirm that the team 'has a named fallback contact', omitting the recording action and its required completed state. A named or verbally identified contact need not be recorded. The remaining existing and added facts, incident conditions and review gates are preserved.
criteria.consequence: Required for the corresponding functional or invocation outcome; reported separately.

criteria.reason: A reader following the updated invitation checks could confirm that a contact exists and send invitations without ensuring the required contact record was created. The source notes supplied that concrete preparation action; the edited workflow no longer does. This is the same omission as F1, not another failed execution.
criteria.consequence: Required for the corresponding functional or invocation outcome; reported separately.

criteria.reason: The report is coherently organized, and its revised incident heading makes the report-trigger explicit. Invitation, incident, resumption and review sections remain easy to consume; the missing recording requirement affects fidelity and utility, not readability.
criteria.consequence: Required for the corresponding functional or invocation outcome; reported separately.

procedural_summary: Full body/source/notes reads, baseline commit and full saved diff inspection visible. After comparison the subject clarifies the incident heading but leaves the contact-recording omission in the final artifact. No O5 opportunity established by inspected visible messages.

observations.description: Source report 279 words, new notes 166, output 360; growth +81, with no shortening preference. A shorter addition is not a success when a required action is lost.
observations.consequence: Descriptive comparison; no separate score or automatic length-based preference.

observations.description: The other two original addition outputs explicitly require a recorded contact or tell Nia to record it; all three candidate and all three control outputs also retain recording. Original E is therefore 2/3, candidate and control each 3/3. One miss does not establish a reliable condition effect.
observations.consequence: Descriptive comparison; no separate score or automatic length-based preference.
